description_en: Deactivates log delivery for a flow log
kebab_example: aliyun expressconnectrouter deactivate-flow-log --ecr-id ecr-mezk2idmsd0vx20000 --dry-run false --client-token 02fb3da4-130e-11e9-8e44-000000 --flow-log-id ecr-flog-m5evbtbpt0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeactivateFlowLog

parameters.help_en: The ID of Express Connect Router (ECR)
parameters.name: ecr_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

- **true**: Sends a check request. The service resource is not modified.
- **false** (default): Sends a normal request
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

- **true**：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。

- **false**（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a value from your client. Make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The ClientToken parameter supports only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** of each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the flow log instance
parameters.name: flow_log_id
